$comment: Claude-layout hooks for the bro plugin. SessionStart/PreCompact rehydrate beads context (ready work + active drill frame) so a fresh or compacted session resumes from bd state, not transcript. Commands resolve the plugin root from whichever var the client exports (CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT/DEVIN_PLUGIN_ROOT/PLUGIN_ROOT), fall back to bro on PATH, then npx — and always exit 0 so a missing binary can never stall the session.

hooks.command: P="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-${DEVIN_PLUGIN_ROOT:-${PLUGIN_ROOT:-}}}"; if [ -f "$P/hooks/run.sh" ]; then "$P/hooks/run.sh" session-start || true; elif command -v bro >/dev/null 2>&1; then bro hooks session-start || true; elif command -v npx >/dev/null 2>&1; then npx -y @theplenkov/bro@0 hooks session-start || true; fi; exit 0

P="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-${DEVIN_PLUGIN_ROOT:-${PLUGIN_ROOT:-}}}"; if [ -f "$P/hooks/run.sh" ]; then "$P/hooks/run.sh" pre-compact || true; elif command -v bro >/dev/null 2>&1; then bro hooks pre-compact || true; elif command -v npx >/dev/null 2>&1; then npx -y @theplenkov/bro@0 hooks pre-compact || true; fi; exit 0

P="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-${DEVIN_PLUGIN_ROOT:-${PLUGIN_ROOT:-}}}"; if [ -f "$P/hooks/run.sh" ]; then "$P/hooks/run.sh" prompt-submit || true; elif command -v bro >/dev/null 2>&1; then bro hooks prompt-submit || true; elif command -v npx >/dev/null 2>&1; then npx -y @theplenkov/bro@0 hooks prompt-submit || true; fi; exit 0

P="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-${DEVIN_PLUGIN_ROOT:-${PLUGIN_ROOT:-}}}"; if [ -f "$P/hooks/run.sh" ]; then "$P/hooks/run.sh" post-tool || true; elif command -v bro >/dev/null 2>&1; then bro hooks post-tool || true; elif command -v npx >/dev/null 2>&1; then npx -y @theplenkov/bro@0 hooks post-tool || true; fi; exit 0

P="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-${DEVIN_PLUGIN_ROOT:-${PLUGIN_ROOT:-}}}"; if [ -f "$P/hooks/run.sh" ]; then "$P/hooks/run.sh" stop || true; elif command -v bro >/dev/null 2>&1; then bro hooks stop || true; elif command -v npx >/dev/null 2>&1; then npx -y @theplenkov/bro@0 hooks stop || true; fi; exit 0
